description: Source code for the ST Microelectronics I3G4250D gyroscope driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, conversion, and configuration functions.

methods.name: i3g4250d_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches raw gyroscope data sample from the sensor.

methods.name: i3g4250d_convert
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: i3g4250d_channel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw XYZ gyroscope data to sensor_value based on channel.

methods.name: i3g4250d_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves gyroscope data for specified channel.

methods.name: gyr_odr_to_reg
methods.description: Converts sensor_value to register value for data rate.

methods.name: i3g4250d_init
methods.description: Initializes the gyroscope device, sets filters and data rate.
